QUOTE: `createPost` (`app/actions/remote/post.ts:74`) saves the post locally first, under a pending ID (`pending_post_id`), so it shows in the UI. If `client.createPost` throws... **Any other error**: the post is rewritten with `props.failed = true` and saved.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the post is saved locally before sending and on failure is kept with `props.failed = true`.
